name: net-provider
description: Runtime Browser/Net boundary for exit-mediated web connectivity
author: elastos

authority.reason: Owns Browser/Net requests and keeps raw sockets, DNS, HTTP clients, wallet authority, and host internet access out of app capsules.

interfaces.description: Runtime provider affordance descriptors projected from net-provider authority metadata; descriptors are not grants.
